Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In Step 10, the WebSurfer incorrectly extracted information from the Wikipedia page. The visible text in the viewport (and the actual Wikipedia article) states that Waylon Jennings died in "Chandler, Arizona," which refers to his place of death, not his burial location. The burial information is located in the "Illness and death" section further down the page, which the WebSurfer failed to locate or read correctly. Consequently, the agent hallucinated a specific cemetery name ("Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery") and conflated the city of death (Chandler) with the burial location, creating a false fact that conflicts with the correct information found earlier on Find a Grave (City of Mesa Cemetery, Mesa, Arizona). This error led to a contradictory and ultimately incorrect conclusion regarding the burial place.
